prompt:
Create the actual SIX NEW high-detail isometric RPG WALK animation sprites of 신화-뇌신(여), Mythic Thunder Goddess, in literal NORTH (N) direction. This is a NEW PURE BACK view animation. All six characters face straight UP and AWAY from the camera, not sideways, not a three-quarter side view. The back of the head and blonde bun, blue ribbon knots/trails, shoulder backs, back waist and rear blue split coat are visible. Show ZERO eyes, ZERO nose or face profile, ZERO front chest/breast cups or frontal bodice decoration. The camera views the character's actual BACK surfaces. Anatomical right stays SCREEN RIGHT and anatomical left stays SCREEN LEFT in every pose.

REFERENCE 1 is the dominant NEW N WALK fixed-bone motion/placement scaffold. Paint the character onto its pure-back body orientation and articulated pose intentions. Its line colors and diagram labels are NOT costume details. Do not render any labels, guide lines, diagram marks or grid. REFERENCE 2 is the original identity portrait: sole authority for actual colors, character/equipment identity and design. REFERENCE 3 is the existing native E WALK: only material detail, head/body proportions and exact equipment topology; NEVER copy its E-facing pose, visible face or front chest. This output must show the back of that exact same woman and equipment.

Identity verified from portrait/native source: human young adult female, blonde high curled bun and loose blonde curls, royal-blue ribbon. Gold-trimmed royal-blue fitted uniform/bodice, shoulder openings with white/blue/gold sleeve details, short white pleated skirt with gold edging, long royal-blue split rear coat tails with thin gold trim and original gold geometric/cross-shaped motifs. Black thigh-high boots with fine gold angular trim, gold pointed toes and heels. Preserve all same pieces; resolve their backs coherently. No helmet, wings, horns, fantasy creature anatomy, new armor, second weapon, shield, backpack or added attachment. Preserve rich crafted fabric folds, metallic gold edges and source material finish at the same pixel detail as the saved native sprite sources.

ONE weapon in the anatomical RIGHT HAND, on SCREEN RIGHT, for all six poses. It is the SAME long thin gold double-ended spear/staff: long upper open gold spearhead, an upper turquoise diamond gem in gold framing below its tip, thin straight gold shaft, lower turquoise diamond gem and final gold spear point. Keep both ends, gold framework, turquoise gems and right-hand grip fully coherent. Spear is rigid; it may sway with arm inertia, never bend, duplicate, change length, swap hands or merge with coat. Read the native reference for its exact topology. The guide indicates only position and does not replace that actual equipment shape.

Output transparent RGBA atlas EXACTLY 1024×1536 pixels, exactly TWO COLUMNS × THREE ROWS of 512×512 raw image cells. Temporal order left-to-right then downward, exactly ONE complete character per cell and exactly SIX figures. These are high-pixel-detail raw512 sprites with a VIRTUAL logical1024 per-pose canvas at later import; DO NOT shrink them to half scale. Target neutral phases 0 and 3 WHOLE silhouette alpha bounding height about464 pixels including full staff and boots, all tips inside each raw512 cell, roughly12-20 pixels clear edge margin. Actual foot support projects near raw y480. Keep full character width below about320 pixels. Same head, torso, limbs, hands, outfit parts and equipment dimensions in all six poses. Never scale an individual pose to fit. No cropped tips or clipped boots. Blank space remains genuinely alpha0.

Six genuine in-place WALK phases forming one seamless full two-step loop:
0: anatomical LEFT leg carries weight, LEFT foot planted behind pelvis; RIGHT heel makes its forward contact, knee articulated, toe raised.
1: LEFT support/load and rising hip; RIGHT swing leg passes forward with lifted heel and bent knee. Show actual ground-bearing LEFT contact.
2: RIGHT foot settles and accepts weight; LEFT heel rises into toe-off, rear knee begins flexing.
3: anatomical RIGHT leg carries weight, RIGHT foot planted behind pelvis; LEFT heel makes forward contact, toe raised.
4: RIGHT support/load and rising hip; LEFT swing leg passes forward with lifted heel and bent knee.
5: LEFT foot settles and accepts weight; RIGHT heel rises into toe-off; transitions into phase0.
Pure N perspective naturally foreshortens forward feet toward screen UP and rear feet toward screen DOWN. Do not spread feet sideways to fake the gait. Move the pelvis over the actual support foot, with coherent hip/chest vertical bob and small counterrotation; draw knee and ankle bending, visible lifted heels, toe-off, and alternating planted contacts. The body is walking away, not running, jumping or sliding. Arms counter-swing naturally while right hand retains its one staff. Coat tails, skirt folds and ribbons show restrained lag matching real leg/support changes; no six identical rigid bodies with cosmetic feet changes. Preserve invariant bone lengths and body proportions. Each of the six poses is independently drawn with real articulation and different contacts, not a copy, mirror, rotation, recolor or translated duplicate.

Style: crisp, detailed, hand-painted isometric fantasy game sprites with controlled gold highlights, royal-blue cloth and opaque black boots. Elevated orthographic isometric camera (about35 degrees elevation), fixed lighting and physical scale. All dark body/material pixels remain fully opaque; outside each exact character silhouette alpha0, antialiasing only1-2 pixels on boundary. NO shadows, NO floor, NO aura, NO glow, NO bloom, NO lightning trails, NO scenery, NO text or labels, NO other figures, NO detached ornaments or spare weapons. Keep turquoise gem color contained within actual gems. The result must be the exact same character from a strict pure-back NORTH view in six distinct grounded WALK poses.
